name: doxa
description: Your Encouragement Vault in ChatGPT: keep, recall and give what has been spoken over you. Plus exact Scripture (Berean Standard Bible), quote checks, encouragement from Scripture and real testimonies.

interface.longDescription:
Your Encouragement Vault, in your chat.

Sign in with your Doxa account and keep an encouragement or prophecy someone gave you. Ask what has been spoken over you about waiting, your family or your calling. Doxa brings it back by topic, quoted exactly from your own record, with who gave it and when. Give an encouragement you have kept to someone as a private link they can open without the app.

Scripture you can trust. Look up any Bible verse, chapter or whole book, word for word from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Never a paraphrase. Heard a verse quoted and not sure it is right? Paste it in. Doxa tells you if it is exact, close with small differences, another translation's wording, not the BSB wording (with each word that differs), the wrong reference, or not found in the Bible.

Encouragement from Scripture. Tell Doxa what you are going through and get encouragement from Scripture, with each verse linked. Doxa points you to Jesus and to the real people around you: your friends and your church. It never speaks as Jesus or as anyone in the Bible. It never invents a prophecy. It is not a companion.

Real testimonies. Ask for testimonies and Doxa finds real stories from the Grace Record of what God has done, with links.

Scripture, quote checks, encouragement and testimonies work without an account.

Every prophecy in Doxa comes from a person who gave it.
capabilities: Keep an encouragement or prophecy someone gave you in your Encouragement Vault
Recall what has been spoken over you by topic, quoted exactly from your own record
Give an encouragement you have kept as a private link anyone can open without the app
Look up any Bible verse, chapter or book, word for word from the Berean Standard Bible
Check a Bible quote: exact, close, another translation, misquote, wrong reference or not found
Get encouragement from Scripture for what you are going through, with each verse linked
Find real testimonies of what God has done, with links
defaultPrompt: What has been spoken over me about waiting?
Is "God helps those who help themselves" in the Bible?
I'm anxious about a hard conversation tomorrow. Encourage me from Scripture.

positive.prompt: Use Doxa: what is the exact wording of Philippians 4:13?
positive.expected_behavior: A Doxa Scripture card shows Philippians 4:13 word for word from the Berean Standard Bible ("I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.") with a Read in context link to doxa.app.

positive.description: Check a misquoted verse (no sign-in needed)
positive.prompt: Use Doxa to check this quote: "I can do anything I set my mind to through Christ who gives me strength" (Philippians 4:13).
positive.expected_behavior: The card marks the quote as not the BSB wording, shows the exact verse, and highlights each word that differs.

positive.description: Keep an encouragement someone gave (signed in as the test account)
positive.prompt: Use Doxa to keep this encouragement my friend Sam gave me today: "God has not forgotten you; this season of waiting is not wasted." Psalm 27:14.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user allows the write, Doxa saves it to the test account's Encouragement Vault from Sam, with Psalm 27:14 linked, and confirms what was saved.

positive.description: Recall what has been spoken over the user by topic (signed in)
positive.prompt: Use Doxa: what has been spoken over me about waiting?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's own records about waiting, quoted exactly with who gave them and when, for example the prophecy "Roots before fruit" from Ruth (prayer team), Isaiah 40:31.

positive.description: Give a kept encouragement as a private link (signed in)
positive.prompt: Use Doxa to give my "A peacemaker in the family" encouragement to my sister Anna, and show me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user allows the write, Doxa returns a private doxa.app/invite/... link for Anna, marked pending, that opens without the app. Asking again returns the same link.

negative.prompt: Use Doxa to give me a prophecy about my future.

negative.description: Role-playing Jesus or acting as a companion
negative.prompt: Use Doxa so I can text with Jesus.
Use Doxa to show me my friend Sam's encouragements.

review.commerce_description: Doxa does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Every tool in the plugin works without payment.

publication.release_notes: The Encouragement Vault now comes first: the listing and the get-started guide lead with keeping, recalling and giving what has been spoken over you, then exact Berean Standard Bible Scripture and quote checks, then encouragement from Scripture and Grace Record testimonies. The tools do not change.
